summary: Three independent QA runs exercised the backend API and desktop/mobile frontend flows. Core metadata, tool, ecosystem, guidance, decision happy paths, README refresh, navigation, tabs, wizard, search, theme persistence, and responsive behavior were largely working. The same minor backend validation gap was found by all three runs; each run also found a distinct minor frontend issue: missing stable test IDs, platform-insensitive wizard guidance, and raw HTML shown in cached README content.

minor.title: Decision API accepts unknown enum values
minor.expected: HTTP 422 with validation details for unsupported questionnaire values.
minor.actual: HTTP 200 returns a recommendation because the five DecisionAnswers fields are unconstrained strings; one run observed a graft-only recommendation with 18% estimated savings.
minor.impact: Malformed or out-of-contract clients can receive misleading recommendations instead of a useful client validation error.

ui_bugs.title: Several interactive links and buttons lack required data-testid attributes
ui_bugs.location: SearchModal close button; ToolDetail back link; Guidance adoption-step buttons; PlatformView tool-name buttons and other navigation links
ui_bugs.steps_to_reproduce: Inspect or automate the listed rendered controls; unlike the primary controls, these elements have no data-testid attribute.
ui_bugs.expected: All user-interactive navigation and control elements expose stable data-testid hooks per the product testability requirement.
ui_bugs.actual: Some controls can only be selected by text, CSS, or role.
ui_bugs.impact: Reliable automated regression coverage and future maintenance are harder; no end-user navigation failure was observed.

integration_issues.title: Wizard platform selection does not adapt setup guidance
integration_issues.steps_to_reproduce: Open the Graft setup wizard, select Mac, record Step 1 command, validation, and troubleshooting content, then change platform to Windows and inspect the same step.
integration_issues.expected: Commands, validation, and troubleshooting should adapt to the selected platform.
integration_issues.actual: Mac and Windows show shared content such as npm install -g @trailhq/graft, graft --version, and the same troubleshooting text; selection changes mainly the terminal label/icon.
integration_issues.impact: Users on Windows, WSL, containers, remote SSH, or other environments may copy commands that are not appropriate for their platform; the platform gate is mostly cosmetic for setup steps.

integration_issues.title: Fetched GitHub README displays raw HTML markup as visible text
integration_issues.steps_to_reproduce: Open /tools/graft, select data-testid=tool-tab-readme, then inspect data-testid=tab-content-readme after the cached README loads or click refresh-github-button.
integration_issues.expected: GitHub README markdown, including supported HTML blocks, images, and links, is rendered as formatted README content.
integration_issues.actual:
The content visibly begins with literal strings such as
, , and ; raw HTML source is shown in the README card rather than rendered.
integration_issues.impact: README presentation is cluttered and important repository badges, images, and links are not usable as formatted documentation.

action_items: Constrain all five DecisionAnswers choice fields with the supported Literal/Enum values and return HTTP 422 for unknown values.
Add stable data-testid attributes to the remaining interactive controls called out by the QA run.
Provide platform-specific wizard commands, validation, and troubleshooting guidance rather than changing only the terminal label/icon.
Render or safely sanitize supported HTML in fetched GitHub README markdown instead of displaying raw markup.
